modelRouting.routingRationale: Two settled disjoint Rust repairs under the operator's hard Luna-worker rule

objective: Complete corrected M5 by wiring the frozen effects-owned ExternalProjectTool boundary through every native application invocation and correcting Windows process cleanup truth, without reopening the ten-path core interface.
integrationOwner: current orchestrator; sole owner of integration HEAD, index, generated state, validation, commits, receipts, and push; integrates worker patches without authoring worker-owned implementation

preconditions.coreRule: The frozen ten-path M5 core is immutable and both workers start from this exact reachable commit.
preconditions.legacyRule: Node/Python runtime paths are read-only evidence until M7; Membrane is excluded.
preconditions.qualificationRule: No M6 PASS or M7 deletion claim is authorized.

completionChecks: both exact allowlists reconcile with no overlap or Cargo.lock change
application composition reaches ProviderContext on Invoke, Run, RunRequest, custom RunSource, and cancellation flows
application and scheduler never drop an active provider/effect future on cancellation or deadline; bounded cleanup preserves terminal evidence and forces incomplete truth
Windows timeout, cancellation, output-limit, and normal-exit receipts report actual cleanup truth
all declared direct-Cargo checks pass and frozen core bytes remain unchanged
legacy runtime and Membrane paths remain untouched

workers.executor: Luna Rust worker in isolated worktree; no stage, commit, or push
checks: from engine: cargo test -p legion-effects --test windows_process_tree --locked
prove suspended creation, job assignment, resume, cooperative grace, hard cleanup, bounded output, and reaping remain intact
prove kill_succeeded cannot be true when required cleanup fails

workers.executor: Luna Rust worker in isolated worktree; no stage, commit, or push
checks: from engine: cargo check -p legion-runtime -p legion-application --locked
from engine: cargo test -p legion-testkit --test native_effects --locked
prove one optional typed seam is bound on Invoke, Run, RunRequest, custom RunSource, and cancellation paths
prove cancellation and deadline signal then await bounded provider/effect cleanup, retain terminal evidence, and never drop an active future
prove non-cooperative provider cleanup returns bounded explicit incomplete cleanup-unconfirmed evidence
prove runtime and SDK never construct EffectExecutor, evaluate policy, spawn a process, or synthesize success

stopConditions: source revision or frozen authority changes
a worker-owned path is dirty before execution
implementation requires a path outside exact allowlist
frozen M5 core interface would need modification
runtime would construct an executor or evaluate policy
legacy runtime or Membrane modification would be required
